title: Bose Soundbar Error 1
shortDescription: General system fault detected on the soundbar.
fullDescription:
Bose Soundbar Error 1 is a generic internal system fault reported by the Music app or shown on the soundbar's display.

It can indicate a failed self-test at boot, a network configuration problem, or a temporary firmware issue.

Power cycling the soundbar and updating firmware typically clears the error.

fixSteps.title: Power cycle
fixSteps.instruction: Unplug the soundbar for 60 seconds and plug back in.

fixSteps.title: Update firmware
fixSteps.instruction: Open Bose Music app and run any available update.

whenToCallPro: Contact Bose if error persists after reset.

faq.a: Usually no; firmware or config related.

title: Bose Soundbar Error 2
fullDescription:
Error 2 indicates the soundbar could not authenticate with the WiFi network or Bose cloud services.

Typically caused by incorrect credentials or router security settings that are incompatible with the soundbar's WiFi chip.

fixSteps.title: Re-enter WiFi
fixSteps.instruction: Run setup again through the Bose Music app.

fixSteps.title: Adjust router security
fixSteps.instruction: Switch router to WPA2 or mixed mode.

whenToCallPro: Only if router cannot be changed.

faq.a: Not on all models; check your model's spec sheet.

title: Bose Soundbar Error 3
fullDescription:
Error 3 appears during or after a failed firmware update. The soundbar may continue to function but will repeatedly prompt to finish the update.

Use a wired Ethernet connection if available to ensure stability during the retry.

fixSteps.title: Reboot and retry
fixSteps.instruction: Power cycle and run the update again.

whenToCallPro: If unit fails to boot after update.

faq.a: Some features require the latest firmware.

title: Bose Soundbar HDMI CEC Not Working
shortDescription: TV remote cannot control the soundbar over HDMI.
fullDescription:
When CEC (Consumer Electronics Control) is not functional, the TV remote cannot adjust soundbar volume or power it on/off.

The issue often lies in TV settings (CEC labeled differently per brand) or a cable that does not carry CEC signals.
symptoms: Power on TV doesn't turn on soundbar

fixSteps.title: Enable CEC on TV
fixSteps.instruction: Set Anynet+/Bravia Sync/HDMI-CEC to On in TV settings.

faq.q: What's CEC called on my TV?
faq.a: Samsung Anynet+, Sony Bravia Sync, LG SimpLink.

title: Bose Soundbar WiFi Connection Failed
shortDescription: Soundbar cannot connect to wireless network.
fullDescription: A WiFi connection failure on a Bose soundbar usually arises during the Music app setup. Causes include incorrect password, signal weakness, or router restrictions on IoT devices.

fixSteps.title: Move closer to router
fixSteps.instruction: Test by placing the soundbar near the router temporarily.

fixSteps.title: Re-run setup
fixSteps.instruction: Open Bose Music app and add the product again.

videoSearchQuery: Bose soundbar WiFi connection failed fix

faq.a: Yes, newer Bose soundbars have an Ethernet port.

title: Bose SoundTouch Error
fullDescription:
SoundTouch-compatible soundbars (300/500) occasionally report errors communicating with the SoundTouch cloud service. Bose has migrated many features to Bose Music, so legacy services may be slower or unavailable.

Use the SoundTouch app to re-link or reset the product.

fixSteps.title: Log out and back in
fixSteps.instruction: In the SoundTouch app, log out of your account and sign back in.

faq.a: Yes, Bose now focuses on the Bose Music platform.

title: Bose Soundbar Won't Turn On
fullDescription:
A Bose soundbar that won't power on may have a failed power supply, loose connection, or firmware hang.

Try a different outlet and a long unplug cycle before assuming hardware failure.

fixSteps.title: Long unplug
fixSteps.instruction: Unplug for 2 minutes, then plug into a known-good outlet.

fixSteps.title: Check power cable
fixSteps.instruction: Inspect and reseat the detachable power cable.

whenToCallPro: If no lights after all power checks.
videoSearchQuery: Bose soundbar won't turn on fix

faq.a: Usually yes if within 1 year of purchase.

title: Bose Remote Not Responding
shortDescription: The Bose remote has no effect on the soundbar.
fullDescription:
Remote issues typically come from dead batteries, a blocked IR sensor, or remote pairing loss (on universal remotes).

Test with replacement batteries first and verify nothing obstructs the IR window on the soundbar.

fixSteps.title: Replace batteries
fixSteps.instruction: Use fresh AA/AAA batteries of correct orientation.

fixSteps.title: Clear sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Remove any obstruction in front of the soundbar IR window.

faq.q: Can I use the Bose Music app as a remote?
faq.a: Yes, the app fully controls the soundbar.

title: Bose Bluetooth Pairing Failed
shortDescription: Phone or tablet cannot pair to the soundbar via Bluetooth.
fullDescription:
Bluetooth pairing failures are usually due to a crowded pairing list on the soundbar, interference, or the source device being out of discovery mode.

Clearing the Bluetooth list on the soundbar often resolves persistent failures.

fixSteps.title: Clear Bluetooth list
fixSteps.instruction: Hold the Bluetooth button for 10 seconds to clear paired devices.

fixSteps.title: Re-pair phone
fixSteps.instruction: Enable Bluetooth on the phone and select the Bose soundbar.

faq.a: Bose soundbars remember up to 8 devices.

title: Bose Soundbar Audio Dropouts
shortDescription: Audio cuts in and out intermittently.
fullDescription:
Dropouts on a Bose soundbar can be caused by WiFi congestion, Bluetooth interference, or a marginal HDMI cable.

Determine the source (HDMI, WiFi, or Bluetooth) and focus troubleshooting there.

fixSteps.title: Change WiFi channel
fixSteps.instruction: Move to a less crowded 5GHz channel in router settings.

fixSteps.title: Replace HDMI cable
fixSteps.instruction: Try a new certified high-speed HDMI cable.

faq.a: Atmos requires more bandwidth, exposing marginal cables.

title: WiFi Setup Required
fullDescription: Yellow flashing front bar means the Bose soundbar is in setup mode awaiting WiFi.

fixSteps.title: Open Bose Music
fixSteps.instruction: Add product in Bose Music app.

faq.a: Yes - HDMI ARC works without WiFi but app features need it.

title: Critical Error
fullDescription: Solid red light bar indicates the soundbar reported a fatal error.

fullDescription: ADAPTiQ tuning fails partway through - headset connection or noise issue.

fixSteps.instruction: Reseat the ADAPTiQ headset connector at rear.

title: Discovery Failure
fullDescription: Bose Music app does not see the soundbar on the network during setup or browse.

fixSteps.title: Same WiFi
fixSteps.instruction: Ensure phone on same SSID as soundbar.

fixSteps.title: Disable AP isolation
fixSteps.instruction: Turn off router AP isolation/guest mode.

videoSearchQuery: Bose Bose Music App Cannot Find Bar fix

faq.a: Bose supports both - either works for setup.

title: AirPlay Buffering Failure
fullDescription: AirPlay 2 audio cuts out mid-stream due to WiFi or buffer issues.

fixSteps.title: Use 5 GHz
fixSteps.instruction: Connect soundbar to 5 GHz SSID for less congestion.

title: Sub Pairing Failed
fullDescription: Bass Module fails to pair with the soundbar - LED on sub stays solid white instead of green.

fixSteps.title: Move closer
fixSteps.instruction: Place sub within 30 feet during pairing.

videoSearchQuery: Bose Bass Module Not Pairing fix

faq.a: Bass Module 500/700/900 work with current bars; check compat.

title: Mic or Cloud Issue
shortDescription: Alexa or Google does not wake.
fullDescription: Voice assistant does not respond to wake word - mic muted or cloud unreachable.

fixSteps.title: Unmute mic
fixSteps.instruction: Press mic button on top - LED off when active.

fixSteps.title: Re-link assistant
fixSteps.instruction: Re-link Alexa/Google in Bose Music app.

videoSearchQuery: Bose Voice Assistant Not Responding fix

faq.a: Choose one - Alexa or Google, not both simultaneously.

title: Atmos Not Detected
shortDescription: Dolby Atmos badge missing from playback.
fullDescription: Soundbar 900 not displaying Atmos despite Atmos source - bitstream or eARC issue.

fixSteps.title: Use eARC
fixSteps.instruction: Connect Soundbar 900 to TV eARC port with Ultra High Speed cable.

fixSteps.title: TV passthrough
fixSteps.instruction: Set TV audio output to bitstream/passthrough.

videoSearchQuery: Bose Dolby Atmos Not Active fix

faq.a: Disney+, Netflix premium, Apple TV+ have Atmos titles.
